positions.source_passage: No medical device should be cleared for marketing without following Good Practices already in place including but not limited to establishing formal requirements and specifications as well as verification and and formal and definitive validation tests and procedures.
positions.position_gist: Marketing clearance of any device, including GenAI-enabled devices, should require adherence to existing Good Practices—formal requirements and specifications plus verification and definitive validation testing—rather than any lesser evidentiary showing.

positions.source_passage: Or if you don't feel like requiring that, I just want to state for the record that uncomnstrained generative AI will place patients at risk of grievous harm.
positions.position_gist: The commenter warns that if FDA does not require formal verification and validation before clearance, unconstrained generative AI will expose patients to grievous harm—implicitly opposing acceptance of greater premarket uncertainty.
